verses.en: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
verses.pt: Contou-lhes também uma parábola sobre o dever de orar sempre, e nunca desfalecer.
verses.en_web: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray, and not give up,
verses.en_bbe: And he made a story for them, the point of which was that men were to go on making prayer and not get tired;

verses.en: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:
verses.pt: dizendo: Havia em certa cidade um juiz que não temia a Deus, nem respeitava os homens.
verses.en_web: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God, and didn’t respect man.
verses.en_bbe: Saying, There was a judge in a certain town, who had no fear of God or respect for man:

verses.en: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.
verses.pt: Havia também naquela mesma cidade uma viúva que ia ter com ele, dizendo: Faze-me justiça contra o meu adversário.
verses.en_web: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’
verses.en_bbe: And there was a widow in that town, and she kept on coming to him and saying, Give me my right against the man who has done me wrong.

verses.en: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;
verses.pt: E por algum tempo não quis atendê-la; mas depois disse consigo: Ainda que não temo a Deus, nem respeito os homens,
verses.en_web: He wouldn’t for a while, but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God, nor respect man,
verses.en_bbe: And for a time he would not: but later, he said to himself, Though I have no fear of God or respect for man,

verses.en: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.
verses.pt: todavia, como esta viúva me incomoda, hei de fazer-lhe justiça, para que ela não continue a vir molestar-me.
verses.en_web: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”
verses.en_bbe: Because this widow is a trouble to me, I will give her her right; for if not, I will be completely tired out by her frequent coming.

verses.en: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.
verses.pt: Prosseguiu o Senhor: Ouvi o que diz esse juiz injusto.
verses.en_web: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said, Give ear to the words of the evil judge.

verses.en: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?
verses.pt: E não fará Deus justiça aos seus escolhidos, que dia e noite clamam a ele, já que é longânimo para com eles?
verses.en_web: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones, who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?
verses.en_bbe: And will not God do right in the cause of his saints, whose cries come day and night to his ears, though he is long in doing it?

verses.en: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
verses.pt: Digo-vos que depressa lhes fará justiça. Contudo quando vier o Filho do homem, porventura achará fé na terra?
verses.en_web: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”
verses.en_bbe: I say to you that he will quickly do right in their cause. But when the Son of man comes, will there be any faith on earth?

verses.en: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:
verses.pt: Propôs também esta parábola a uns que confiavam em si mesmos, crendo que eram justos, e desprezavam os outros:
verses.en_web: He spoke also this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others.
verses.en_bbe: And he made this story for some people who were certain that they were good, and had a low opinion of others:

verses.en: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.
verses.pt: Dois homens subiram ao templo para orar; um fariseu, e o outro publicano.
verses.en_web: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.
verses.en_bbe: Two men went up to the Temple for prayer; one a Pharisee, and the other a tax-farmer.

verses.en: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
verses.pt: O fariseu, de pé, assim orava consigo mesmo: Ó Deus, graças te dou que não sou como os demais homens, roubadores, injustos, adúlteros, nem ainda com este publicano.
verses.en_web: The Pharisee stood and prayed to himself like this: ‘God, I thank you, that I am not like the rest of men, extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.
verses.en_bbe: The Pharisee, taking up his position, said to himself these words: God, I give you praise because I am not like other men, who take more than their right, who are evil-doers, who are untrue to their wives, or even like this tax-farmer.

verses.en: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
verses.pt: Jejuo duas vezes na semana, e dou o dízimo de tudo quanto ganho.
verses.en_web: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’
verses.en_bbe: Twice in the week I go without food; I give a tenth of all I have.

verses.en: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
verses.pt: Mas o publicano, estando em pé de longe, nem ainda queria levantar os olhos ao céu, mas batia no peito, dizendo: Ó Deus, sê propício a mim, o pecador!
verses.en_web: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’
verses.en_bbe: The tax-farmer, on the other hand, keeping far away, and not lifting up even his eyes to heaven, made signs of grief and said, God, have mercy on me, a sinner.

verses.en: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
verses.pt: Digo-vos que este desceu justificado para sua casa, e não aquele; porque todo o que a si mesmo se exaltar será humilhado; mas o que a si mesmo se humilhar será exaltado.
verses.en_web: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”
verses.en_bbe: I say to you, This man went back to his house with God's approval, and not the other: for everyone who makes himself high will be made low and whoever makes himself low will be made high.

verses.en: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
verses.pt: Traziam-lhe também as crianças, para que as tocasse; mas os discípulos, vendo isso, os repreendiam.
verses.en_web: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
verses.en_bbe: And they took their children to him, so that he might put his hands on them: but when the disciples saw it, they said sharp words to them

verses.en: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
verses.pt: Jesus, porém, chamando-as para si, disse: Deixai vir a mim as crianças, e não as impeçais, porque de tais é o reino de Deus.
verses.en_web: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.
verses.en_bbe: But Jesus sent for them, saying, Let the children come to me, and do not keep them away, for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.
verses.pt: Em verdade vos digo que, qualquer que não receber o reino de Deus como criança, de modo algum entrará nele.
verses.en_web: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
verses.en_bbe: Truly I say to you, Whoever does not put himself under the kingdom of God like a little child, will not come into it at all.

verses.en: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
verses.pt: E perguntou-lhe um dos principais: Bom Mestre, que hei de fazer para herdar a vida eterna?
verses.en_web: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
verses.en_bbe: And a certain ruler put a question to him, saying, Good Master, what have I to do so that I may have eternal life?

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Por que me chamas bom? Ninguém é bom, senão um, que é Deus.
verses.en_web: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one—God.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said to him, Why do you say that I am good? No one is good, but only God.

verses.en: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.
verses.pt: Sabes os mandamentos: Não adulterarás; não matarás; não furtarás; não dirás falso testemunho; honra a teu pai e a tua mãe.
verses.en_web: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”
verses.en_bbe: You have knowledge of what the law says: Do not be untrue to your wife, Do not put anyone to death, Do not take what is not yours, Do not give false witness, Give honour to your father and mother.

verses.en: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.
verses.pt: Replicou o homem: Tudo isso tenho guardado desde a minha juventude.
verses.en_web: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, All these things I have done from the time when I was a boy.

verses.en: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
verses.pt: Quando Jesus ouviu isso, disse-lhe: Ainda te falta uma coisa; vende tudo quanto tens e reparte-o pelos pobres, e terás um tesouro no céu; e vem, segue-me.
verses.en_web: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have, and distribute it to the poor. You will have treasure in heaven. Come, follow me.”
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, hearing it, said to him, One thing you still have need of; get money for your goods, and give it away to the poor, and you will have wealth in heaven; and come after me.

verses.en: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.
verses.pt: Mas, ouvindo ele isso, encheu-se de tristeza; porque era muito rico.
verses.en_web: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.
verses.en_bbe: But at these words he became very sad, for he had great wealth.

verses.en: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.pt: E Jesus, vendo-o assim, disse: Quão dificilmente entrarão no reino de Deus os que têm riquezas!
verses.en_web: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, looking at him, said, How hard it is for those who have wealth to get into the kingdom of God!

verses.en: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.pt: Pois é mais fácil um camelo passar pelo fundo duma agulha, do que entrar um rico no reino de Deus.
verses.en_web: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
verses.en_bbe: It is simpler for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a man who has much money to come into the kingdom of God.

verses.en: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?
verses.pt: Então os que ouviram isso disseram: Quem pode, então, ser salvo?
verses.en_web: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”
verses.en_bbe: And those who were present said, Then who may have salvation?

verses.en: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes: As coisas que são impossíveis aos homens são possíveis a Deus.
verses.en_web: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”
verses.en_bbe: But he said, Things which are not possible with man are possible with God.

verses.en: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe Pedro: Eis que nós deixamos tudo, e te seguimos.
verses.en_web: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything, and followed you.”
verses.en_bbe: And Peter said, See, we have given up what is ours to come after you.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God’s sake,
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Em verdade vos digo que ninguém há que tenha deixado casa, ou mulher, ou irmãos, ou pais, ou filhos, por amor do reino de Deus,
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Truly I say to you, There is no man who has given up house or wife or brothers or father or mother or children, because of the kingdom of God,

verses.en: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
verses.pt: que não haja de receber no presente muito mais, e no mundo vindouro a vida eterna.
verses.en_web: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”
verses.en_bbe: Who will not get much more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.

verses.en: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.
verses.pt: Tomando Jesus consigo os doze, disse-lhes: Eis que subimos a Jerusalém e se cumprirá no filho do homem tudo o que pelos profetas foi escrito;
verses.en_web: He took the twelve aside, and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.
verses.en_bbe: And he took with him the twelve and said to them, Now we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things which were said by the prophets will be done to the Son of man.

verses.en: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:
verses.pt: pois será entregue aos gentios, e escarnecido, injuriado e cuspido;
verses.en_web: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.
verses.en_bbe: For he will be given up to the Gentiles, and will be made sport of and put to shame:

verses.en: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.pt: e depois de o açoitarem, o matarão; e ao terceiro dia ressurgirá.
verses.en_web: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”
verses.en_bbe: And he will be given cruel blows and put to death, and on the third day he will come back to life.

verses.en: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
verses.pt: Mas eles não entenderam nada disso; essas palavras lhes eram obscuras, e não percebiam o que lhes dizia.
verses.en_web: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.
verses.en_bbe: But they did not take in the sense of any of these words, and what he said was not clear to them, and their minds were not able to see it.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
verses.pt: Ora, quando ele ia chegando a Jericó, estava um cego sentado junto do caminho, mendigando.
verses.en_web: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.
verses.en_bbe: And it came about that when he got near Jericho, a certain blind man was seated by the side of the road, making requests for money from those who went by.

verses.en: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.
verses.pt: Este, pois, ouvindo passar a multidão, perguntou que era aquilo.
verses.en_web: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.
verses.en_bbe: And hearing the sound of a great number of people going by, he said, What is this?

verses.en: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
verses.pt: Disseram-lhe que Jesus, o nazareno, ia passando.
verses.en_web: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.
verses.en_bbe: And they said to him, Jesus of Nazareth is going by.

verses.en: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.pt: Então ele se pôs a clamar, dizendo: Jesus, Filho de Davi, tem compaixão de mim!
verses.en_web: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
verses.en_bbe: And he said in a loud voice, Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me.

verses.en: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.pt: E os que iam à frente repreendiam-no, para que se calasse; ele, porém, clamava ainda mais: Filho de Davi, tem compaixão de mim!
verses.en_web: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
verses.en_bbe: And those who were in front made protests and said to him, Be quiet: but he said all the more, O Son of David, have mercy on me.

verses.en: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
verses.pt: Parou, pois, Jesus, e mandou que lho trouxessem. Tendo ele chegado, perguntou-lhe:
verses.en_web: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, stopping, gave orders that he was to come to him, and when he came near, he said to him,

verses.en: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.
verses.pt: Que queres que te faça? Respondeu ele: Senhor, que eu veja.
verses.en_web: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”
verses.en_bbe: What would you have me do for you? And he said, Lord, that I may be able to see again.

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Vê; a tua fé te salvou.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said, See again: your faith has made you well.

verses.en: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.
verses.pt: Imediatamente recuperou a vista, e o foi seguindo, gloficando a Deus. E todo o povo, vendo isso, dava louvores a Deus.
verses.en_web: Immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.
verses.en_bbe: And straight away he was able to see, and he went after him, giving glory to God; and all the people when they saw it gave praise to God.
